en.ammaar-muslim: 6. [6/364] al-Kafi: Muhammad b. Yahya from Ahmad b. Muhammad from al-Husayn b. Sa’id from al-Hasan b. Mahbub from Abdallah b. Sinan from Abi Abdillah عليه السلام who said:
Nothing becomes apparent to Allah concerning something (to make Him change His decree) except that it was in His knowledge before it appears to Him (to change it).
